mapper.select: SELECT id, scope, target_id, reason, halted_by, active, halted_at, resumed_at, resume_reason FROM quantpf_trading_halt WHERE active=1 AND scope=#{scope} AND (target_id=#{targetId} OR (target_id IS NULL AND #{targetId} IS NULL)) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quantpf_trading_halt (scope, target_id, reason, halted_by, active, halted_at) VALUES (#{scope}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{haltedBy}, 1, #{haltedAt})
